distractors.reason: 'Loudly' describes sound, not how a computer performs. 'Work loudly' is not a natural collocation.
'Heavily' does not describe the speed of a device working. 'Work heavily' sounds unnatural here.
'Tightly' describes something held or closed firmly. It does not describe how a laptop works.

example_sentence: My old laptop works ___ when I open many tabs.
l1_interference: Носії української мови часто ставлять прислівник перед дієсловом, тому можуть казати 'slowly work' замість 'work slowly'. В англійській мові прислівник зазвичай стоїть після дієслова.
explanation: Verb-adverb collocations usually place the adverb after the verb. 'Slowly' describes how the laptop performs the action of working, so it comes after 'works'.

related_collocations.example: She can type quickly on her phone.
The website loads slowly on my old tablet.
Please download the file quickly before the link expires.

memory_tip: In English the adverb usually comes AFTER the verb: work slowly, type quickly, load slowly
